content.text: Labeled for organ-rejection prophylaxis in adult and peds (≥ 3 mo) kidney, ♡ or liver transplant recipients, w other immunosuppressants.

preg: ↑ first-trimester loss and congenital malformations; ⍉if safer options exist; counsel females of reprod potential on preg prev and planning; ↑ lymphoma and other malig, esp skin; ↑ bact, viral, fungal and protozoal infect, incl opportunistic infect and HBV/HCV reactivation; can be fatal.
Neutropenia (ANC < 1.3 K/µL): interrupt or reduce the dose.
